finding: With no key, no account, no wallet and no payment on 2026-10-27 at 06:12:31Z, the documented x402 price route answers 402 with an x402 version 2 document offering three ways to pay rather than September's two: scheme exact, 5000 units of USDC on Base, on Solana mainnet or on Polygon. The price is half what the 2026-09-11, 09-19 and 09-28 readings found (10000 units, $0.01) and half what the vendor's x402 page still documents at 06:14Z, and Polygon is a network that page does not name. maxTimeoutSeconds stays 60. The page tells a caller to take the price from the 402 rather than from the page, which is the only reason the divergence is not a defect in either. No payment was made and the paid retry was not attempted, so whether data is served after payment is still not measured by this registry. One IP is one sample, and when the price changed between 2026-09-28 and today is not readable from here.
